description_for_human: Open-source GEO (Generative Engine Optimization) audit tool for AI search visibility across 11 dimensions and 20 AI crawlers.
description_for_model: GeoScore audits public websites for AI search visibility (Generative Engine Optimization) across 11 weighted dimensions and 20 AI crawlers, then generates llms.txt, robots.txt, and JSON-LD fixes. Use https://geoscore.help/ai/summary.json and https://geoscore.help/ai/faq.json for structured site metadata, https://geoscore.help/llms.txt for curated documentation, and https://geoscore.help/badge/{domain} for live SVG readiness badges. Also available as an npm CLI (npx geoscore <url>) and MCP server (geoscore-mcp).
